decisions.reason: Confirming the competitor design-reference URL does not change the Shatter House brand name or Ridgehaven brand identity.
The confirmed URL is a design reference, not a change to the master website domain or its routing.
Identifying the competitor design-reference URL does not alter support for additional locations or the existing consistent-template strategy.
The design-reference confirmation does not change the requirement for the master site to display and link to available locations.
The competitor design-reference URL has no necessary effect on separate revenue and sales tracking for each location.
The competitor design-reference URL does not change the requirement that each location manage and track its bookings separately.
